PhD opportunity! We are looking for a talented PhD candidate to conduct research into creativity support in generative AI. The role involves studying the creative process and designing/evaluating generative AI in professional design software. Our focus extends beyond the design process and outcome to include user-centric aspects such as self-reflection (see our recent work: https://lnkd.in/eJG28Fb9). You will join a leading Human-Computer Interaction research group committed to excellence in research and a positive, supportive work environment. This three-year fully funded position is based at the Department of Computer Science, Aalborg University in Denmark. More info and apply: https://lnkd.in/e_nWAdn6. Please feel free to reach out if you are interested or have any questions. Thank you for sharing this post with anyone who might be a great fit!

I have done my thesis that directly hit the concept of HCI where we have generated the occluded dataset using GANs to enhance human activity recognition.
